resource_configuration.claim_boundary: Deliberately slower-than-wall-time simulation at requested RTF 0.7 to preserve sensor/computation freshness with rendering on this CPU. Actual wall latency and achieved RTF remain recorded. Passing sim-time safety is NOT evidence of wall-time real-time capability or real-aircraft timing. Identical resources within each class across all four estimators; no relaxed safety thresholds. Earlier failed resource probes remain separately retained.

scope: Intervene on the actual estimator output used by the PX4 follow controller. A shared unchanged adaptive-KF safety/association observer determines gating and tracking identity for all four output methods.

primary_matrix.command: python3 scripts/run_stage1_repetitions.py --prefix stage1_online_estimators_v1 --modes velocity --estimators raw ema fixed_kf adaptive_kf --condition clean --stop-after 4

position_compatibility_matrix.command: python3 scripts/run_stage1_repetitions.py --prefix stage1_position_repetitions_v1 --modes position --estimators adaptive_kf --condition clean --stop-after 4
position_compatibility_matrix.claim_boundary: Repeated engineering compatibility for adaptive-KF position control; not a four-method position-control comparison.

motion_extension.role: Engineering acceleration/deceleration coverage; actual source recordings also support the 10-seed paired offline perturbation study. Four probes are not ten independent repeats of this new trajectory.

pairing: The same seed controls target nominal speed and fault RNG in each method. Each method is a fresh isolated real flight. All other sensing, selection, common adaptive gate, safety ages, controller gains, takeoff and follow distances remain fixed per class.
shared_gate: Original adaptive ConstantVelocityKalman3D with unchanged Q/R-quality formula/threshold. The common gate determines measurement acceptance and association. Raw/EMA/fixed output estimates cannot change gate/selector state. Accepted fixed output updates skip a redundant private gate only after the common gate has accepted. This isolates the output-estimation intervention while preserving safety.

methods.raw: Last accepted 3D position, zero-order hold between acquisitions; velocity is the finite difference of consecutive accepted raw positions using actual acquisition dt and is held for controller feedforward. Output covariance is a declared heuristic, not a KF posterior.
methods.ema: alpha=0.35 on accepted 3D positions, zero-order position hold between acquisitions; finite-difference velocity of consecutive EMA positions using actual source dt; same held feedforward convention and heuristic covariance.
methods.fixed_kf: Six-state CV Kalman output, identical Q and base measurement-noise std, fixed R, shared upstream adaptive safety gate.
methods.adaptive_kf: Original production six-state CV Kalman output and unchanged adaptive quality-dependent R. Default strategy remains this exact original implementation.

freshness: Accepted measurement age >0.75 s loses the selected task and hovers; incoming observation age >0.60 s is rejected. No method can extend thresholds, automatically reselect, or use Gazebo GT at runtime.
primary_outcomes: independently aligned online state calibrated-anchor error with held-out alignment checks
online_accuracy_frame_contract: Schema 2: fixed identity world-from-map rotation from source-declared Gazebo ENU -> PX4 NED -> adapter ROS ENU, verified world ENU/zero heading; only initial 5 s UAV translation/origin calibration, then held-out ego checks. No target or holdout rotation fit. Estimated heading bias remains a physical ego attitude error, not a fitted position-axis rotation. Original schema-1 attitude-derived alignment report is preserved and separately shown as sensitivity. Raw PX4 odometry reset_counter/timeline retained. Source evidence PX4 d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4 GZBridge.cpp:545,713-742; EKF2.cpp:1687-1688; local adapter_node.py:148-154.
statistics: Group by class/method. Trials and seeds, not frames, are statistical units. Report all failures/incomplete starts; Wilson 95% failure-rate interval; means and sample standard deviations; adaptive-minus-baseline paired bootstrap 95% intervals for paired measurable outcomes. Missing failures stay visible and are not imputed as zero; report excluded pairs and coverage. Paired error conditional on common successful/measurable pairs is separately labelled and cannot replace the failure-rate comparison.
failure_retention: Never overwrite failed trials, shorten bags to hide later loss, retune a controller per baseline after seeing its results, or rerun the same seed under the same name until it succeeds. Fixes require a new matrix prefix and all prior evidence remains.
